source: Spacecraft landing, touchdown and impact sites compiled from NASA NSSDCA, PDS, LROC, mission releases and cited papers; every coordinate quotes its page

sites.name: MESSENGER impact site
sites.coordinateNote: Final engineering determination; radius 2438.790 km from the centre of Mercury. Recorded as stated (east longitude); note that IAU Mercury longitudes are positive west. Latitude as stated: not stated.

source.title: NASA Science Photojournal: Best Determination of MESSENGER's Impact Location
source.publisher: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington

sites.quote: The final estimate of the impact location is at 54.4398 N, 210.1205 E, and 2438.790 km from the center of Mercury. The final determination of the impact time is 19:26:01.166 UTC on 30 April 2015.
